title: Arabic Bible, Smith-Van Dyck translation (1865), full Bible, one verse per line
period: 19th century (1865), Modern Standard Arabic of the Smith-Van Dyck Bible
notes: License: 'public-domain' is stated for translation id 'arb_vd' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/arb_vd/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 7,450,127 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'arabic') gives 2,300,811 characters. Vowel marks (harakat), if present, are combining marks and are stripped by the generic normalization.
